# `/trigger-subscriptions` endpoints

Base URL: `https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com`

### POST /trigger-subscriptions/v1

`createSubscriptionV1` — Create a subscription

This API creates a new subscription to a trigger and defines trigger invocation details. The type of subscription determines which config object is required: * HTTP subscriptions require httpConfig * EventBridge subscriptions require eventBridgeConfig

- Scopes: sp:trigger-service-subscriptions:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Body (application/json): subscriptionpostrequest
- Returns 201: subscription

### GET /trigger-subscriptions/v1

`listSubscriptionsV1` — List subscriptions

Gets a list of all trigger subscriptions.

- Scopes: sp:trigger-service-subscriptions:manage, sp:trigger-service-subscriptions:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `limit` (query) — max 250 — default 250 — Max number of results to return. See [API Standard Collection Parameters](https://developer.sailpoint.com/docs/api/standard-collection-parameters) for more information.
  - `offset` (query) — default 0 — Offset into the full result set. Usually specified with *limit* to paginate through the results. See [API Standard Collection…
  - `count` (query) — default False — If *true* it will populate the *X-Total-Count* response header with the number of results that would be returned if *limit* and *offset* were ignored. Since requesting a total count can have a…
  - `filters` (query) — fields: id: eq; triggerId: eq; type: eq, le — e.g. `id eq "12cff757-c0c0-413b-8ad7-2a47956d1e89"`
  - `sorters` (query) — fields: triggerId, triggerName — e.g. `triggerName`
- Returns 200: array of subscription

### PUT /trigger-subscriptions/v1/{id}

`updateSubscriptionV1` — Update a subscription

This API updates a trigger subscription in IdentityNow, using a full object representation. In other words, the existing Subscription is completely replaced. The following fields are immutable: * id * triggerId Attempts to modify these fields result in 400.

- Scopes: sp:trigger-service-subscriptions:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — Subscription ID
- Body (application/json): subscriptionputrequest
- Returns 200: subscription

### PATCH /trigger-subscriptions/v1/{id}

`patchSubscriptionV1` — Patch a subscription

This API updates a trigger subscription in IdentityNow, using a set of instructions to modify a subscription partially. The following fields are patchable: **name**, **description**, **enabled**, **type**, **filter**, **responseDeadline**, **httpConfig**, **eventBridgeConfig**, **workflowConfig**

- Scopes: sp:trigger-service-subscriptions:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — ID of the Subscription to patch
- Body (application/json-patch+json): array of object
- Returns 200: subscription

### DELETE /trigger-subscriptions/v1/{id}

`deleteSubscriptionV1` — Delete a subscription

Deletes an existing subscription to a trigger.

- Scopes: sp:trigger-service-subscriptions:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — Subscription ID
- Returns 204: no body

### POST /trigger-subscriptions/v1/validate-filter

`testSubscriptionFilterV1` — Validate a subscription filter

Validates a JSONPath filter expression against a provided mock input. Request requires a security scope of:

- Scopes: sp:trigger-service-subscriptions:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Body (application/json): validatefilterinputdto
- Returns 200: validatefilteroutputdto
